title: Meta Just Took Their First Step Toward Personal Superintelligence
description:
Meta launched Muse Spark as their first step toward Personal Superintelligence. It lives inside WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger. Handles photos, voice, and text simultaneously. Three reasoning modes. Trained with 1,000+ physicians, outperformed GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro on HealthBench.

Link: https://ai.meta.com
channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies
